paragraphs.text: translated by
1. I WILL extol the most heroic Indra who with his might forced earth and sky asunder;
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रं स्तवा नृतमं यस्य मह्ना विबबाधे रोचना वि ज्मो अन्तान् ।
paragraphs.translit: indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mahnā vibabādhe rocanā vi jmo antān |

paragraphs.text: Who hath filled all with width as man's Upholder, surpassing floods and rivers in his greatness.
paragraphs.original: आ यः पप्रौ चर्षणीधृद्वरोभिः प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचानो महित्वा
paragraphs.translit: ā yaḥ paprau carṣaṇīdhṛdvarobhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā

paragraphs.text: 2. Surya is he: throughout the wide expanses shall Indra turn him, swift as car-wheels, hither,
paragraphs.original: स सूर्यः पर्युरू वरांस्येन्द्रो ववृत्याद्रथ्येव चक्रा ।
paragraphs.translit: sa sūryaḥ paryurū varāṃsyendro vavṛtyādrathyeva cakrā |

paragraphs.text: Like a stream resting not but ever active he hath destroyed, with light, the black hued darkness.
paragraphs.original: अतिष्ठन्तमपस्यं न सर्गं कृष्णा तमांसि त्विष्या जघान
paragraphs.translit: atiṣṭhantamapasyaṃ na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna

paragraphs.text: 3. To him I sing a holy prayer, incessant new, matchless, common to the earth and heaven,
paragraphs.original: समानमस्मा अनपावृदर्च क्ष्मया दिवो असमं ब्रह्म नव्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: samānamasmā anapāvṛdarca kṣmayā divo asamaṃ brahma navyam |

paragraphs.text: Who marks, as they were backs, all living creatures: ne'er doth he fail a friend, the noble Indra.
paragraphs.original: वि यः पृष्ठेव जनिमान्यर्य इन्द्रश्चिकाय न सखायमीषे
paragraphs.translit: vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimānyarya indraścikāya na sakhāyamīṣe

paragraphs.text: 4. I will send forth my songs in flow unceasing, like water from the ocean's depth, to Indra.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रेरयं सगरस्य बुध्नात् ।
paragraphs.translit: indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sagarasya budhnāt |

paragraphs.text: Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.
paragraphs.original: यो अक्षेणेव चक्रिया शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम्
paragraphs.translit: yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhirviṣvaktastambha pṛthivīmuta dyām

paragraphs.text: 5. Rousing with draughts, the Shaker, rushing onward, impetuous, very strong, armed as with arrows
paragraphs.original: आपान्तमन्युस्तृपलप्रभर्मा धुनिः शिमीवाञ्छरुमाँ ऋजीषी ।
paragraphs.translit: āpāntamanyustṛpalaprabharmā dhuniḥ śimīvāñcharumām̐ ṛjīṣī |

paragraphs.text: Is Soma; forest trees and all the bushes deceive not Indra with their offered likeness.
paragraphs.original: सोमो विश्वान्यतसा वनानि नार्वागिन्द्रं प्रतिमानानि देभुः
paragraphs.translit: somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nārvāgindraṃ pratimānāni debhuḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Soma hath flowed to him whom naught can equal, the earth, the heavens, the firmament, the mountains,-
paragraphs.original: न यस्य द्यावापृथिवी न धन्व नान्तरिक्षं नाद्रयः सोमो अक्षाः ।
paragraphs.translit: na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: When heightened in his ire his indignation shatters the firm and breaks the strong in pieces.
paragraphs.original: यदस्य मन्युरधिनीयमानः शृणाति वीळु रुजति स्थिराणि
paragraphs.translit: yadasya manyuradhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḷu rujati sthirāṇi

paragraphs.text: 7. As an axe fells the tree so be slew Vrtra, brake down the strongholds and dug out the rivers.
paragraphs.original: जघान वृत्रं स्वधितिर्वनेव रुरोज पुरो अरदन्न सिन्धून् ।
paragraphs.translit: jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradanna sindhūn |

paragraphs.text: He cleft the mountain like a new-made pitcher. Indra brought forth the kine with his Companions.
paragraphs.original: बिभेद गिरिं नवमिन्न कुम्भमा गा इन्द्रो अकृणुत स्वयुग्भिः
paragraphs.translit: bibheda giriṃ navaminna kumbhamā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Wise art thou, Punisher of guilt, O Indra. The sword lops limbs, thou smitest down the sinner,
paragraphs.original: त्वं ह त्यदृणया इन्द्र धीरोऽसिर्न पर्व वृजिना शृणासि ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ ha tyadṛṇayā indra dhīro'sirna parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi |

paragraphs.text: The men who injure, as it were a comrade, the lofty Law of Varuna and Mitra.
paragraphs.original: प्र ये मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम युजं न जना मिनन्ति मित्रम्
paragraphs.translit: pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram

paragraphs.text: 9. Men who lead evil lives, who break agreements, and injure Varuna, Aryaman and Mitra,-
paragraphs.original: प्र ये मित्रं प्रार्यमणं दुरेवाः प्र संगिरः प्र वरुणं मिनन्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: pra ye mitraṃ prāryamaṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇaṃ minanti |

paragraphs.text: Against these foes, O Mighty Indra, sharpen, as furious death, thy Bull of fiery colour.
paragraphs.original: न्यमित्रेषु वधमिन्द्र तुम्रं वृषन्वृषाणमरुषं शिशीहि
paragraphs.translit: nyamitreṣu vadhamindra tumraṃ vṛṣanvṛṣāṇamaruṣaṃ śiśīhi

paragraphs.text: 10. Indra is Sovran Lord of Earth and Heaven, Indra is Lord of waters and of mountains.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो दिव इन्द्र ईशे पृथिव्या इन्द्रो अपामिन्द्र इत्पर्वतानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra itparvatānām |

paragraphs.text: Indra is Lord of prosperers and sages Indra must be invoked in rest and effort.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो वृधामिन्द्र इन्मेधिराणामिन्द्रः क्षेमे योगे हव्य इन्द्रः
paragraphs.translit: indro vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Vaster than days and nights, Giver of increase, vaster than firmament and flood of ocean,
paragraphs.original: प्राक्तुभ्य इन्द्रः प्र वृधो अहभ्यः प्रान्तरिक्षात्प्र समुद्रस्य धासेः ।
paragraphs.translit: prāktubhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahabhyaḥ prāntarikṣātpra samudrasya dhāseḥ |

paragraphs.text: Vaster than bounds of earth and wind's extension, vaster than rivers and our lands is Indra.
paragraphs.original: प्र वातस्य प्रथसः प्र ज्मो अन्तात्प्र सिन्धुभ्यो रिरिचे प्र क्षितिभ्यः
paragraphs.translit: pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jmo antātpra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. Forward, as herald of refulgent Morning, let thine insatiate arrow fly, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: प्र शोशुचत्या उषसो न केतुरसिन्वा ते वर्ततामिन्द्र हेतिः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra śośucatyā uṣaso na keturasinvā te vartatāmindra hetiḥ |

paragraphs.text: And pierce, as 'twere a stone launched forth from heaven, with hottest blaze the men who love deception.
paragraphs.original: अश्मेव विध्य दिव आ सृजानस्तपिष्ठेन हेषसा द्रोघमित्रान्
paragraphs.translit: aśmeva vidhya diva ā sṛjānastapiṣṭhena heṣasā droghamitrān

paragraphs.text: 13. Him, verily, the moons, the mountains followed, the tall trees followed and the plants and herbage.
paragraphs.original: अन्वह मासा अन्विद्वनान्यन्वोषधीरनु पर्वतासः ।
paragraphs.translit: anvaha māsā anvidvanānyanvoṣadhīranu parvatāsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Yearning with love both Worlds approached, the Waters waited on Indra when he first had being.
paragraphs.original: अन्विन्द्रं रोदसी वावशाने अन्वापो अजिहत जायमानम्
paragraphs.translit: anvindraṃ rodasī vāvaśāne anvāpo ajihata jāyamānam

paragraphs.text: 14. Where was the vengeful dart when thou, O Indra, clavest the demon ever beat on outrage?
paragraphs.original: कर्हि स्वित्सा त इन्द्र चेत्यासदघस्य यद्भिनदो रक्ष एषत् ।
paragraphs.translit: karhi svitsā ta indra cetyāsadaghasya yadbhinado rakṣa eṣat |

paragraphs.text: When fiends lay there upon the ground extended like cattle in the place of immolation?
paragraphs.original: मित्रक्रुवो यच्छसने न गावः पृथिव्या आपृगमुया शयन्ते
paragraphs.translit: mitrakruvo yacchasane na gāvaḥ pṛthivyā āpṛgamuyā śayante

paragraphs.text: 15. Those who are set in enmity against us, the Oganas, O Indra, waxen mighty,-
paragraphs.original: शत्रूयन्तो अभि ये नस्ततस्रे महि व्राधन्त ओगणास इन्द्र ।
paragraphs.translit: śatrūyanto abhi ye nastatasre mahi vrādhanta ogaṇāsa indra |

paragraphs.text: Let blinding darkness follow those our foemen, while these shall have bright shining nights to light them.
paragraphs.original: अन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्तां सुज्योतिषो अक्तवस्ताँ अभि ष्युः
paragraphs.translit: andhenāmitrāstamasā sacantāṃ sujyotiṣo aktavastām̐ abhi ṣyuḥ

paragraphs.text: 16. May plentiful libations of the people, and singing Rsis' holy prayers rejoice thee.
paragraphs.original: पुरूणि हि त्वा सवना जनानां ब्रह्माणि मन्दन्गृणतामृषीणाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānāṃ brahmāṇi mandangṛṇatāmṛṣīṇām |

paragraphs.text: Hearing with love this common invocation, come unto us, pass by all those who praise thee.
paragraphs.original: इमामाघोषन्नवसा सहूतिं तिरो विश्वाँ अर्चतो याह्यर्वाङ्
paragraphs.translit: imāmāghoṣannavasā sahūtiṃ tiro viśvām̐ arcato yāhyarvāṅ

paragraphs.text: 17. O Indra, thus may we be made partakers of thy new favours that shall bring us profit.
paragraphs.original: एवा ते वयमिन्द्र भुञ्जतीनां विद्याम सुमतीनां नवानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: evā te vayamindra bhuñjatīnāṃ vidyāma sumatīnāṃ navānām |

paragraphs.text: Singing with love, may we the Visvamitras win daylight even now through thee, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: विद्याम वस्तोरवसा गृणन्तो विश्वामित्रा उत त इन्द्र नूनम्
paragraphs.translit: vidyāma vastoravasā gṛṇanto viśvāmitrā uta ta indra nūnam

paragraphs.text: 18. Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,
paragraphs.original: शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
paragraphs.translit: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau |

paragraphs.text: The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.
paragraphs.original: शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्
paragraphs.translit: śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
